messages:
Ana (PM): Hey team — Polaris Compute sent over final assets for the joint solution brief. Quick sanity pass please? Need logo clearspace, alt text, approved quote, and hero screenshot sign-off. Link: https://files.redwood.example/polaris-assets.zip
Ravi (Design): taking a look now. do we have a preferred lockup? Polaris included a square and a horizontal.
Marina (Partner Ops): Polaris asked that we use the horizontal lockup on the one-pager, square for social. They also attached brand guidelines PDF.
Ravi (Design): ok. main things I see: horizontal needs 8px more left clearspace on our layout and their color swatch is slightly different — use their primary #0B4F8C not the darker one in the ppt.
Jeff (Marketing): can we get a hero screenshot placeholder? I proposed a mock with their dashboard + our integration callout. If design approves I’ll ask Polaris for the hi-res.
Ravi (Design): yes, export hero at 1920x640, PNG, transparent overlay for copy. Also add alt text for accessibility: "Polaris Compute dashboard showing Redwood inference pipeline and latency graph" — Sam, legal/marketing ok?
Sam (Legal): short on time but that alt text is fine. Need to confirm Polaris approved the co-branded copy and the quote. Who has the quote?
Ana (PM): Quote draft from Polaris: \"Redwood + Polaris reduced inference latency by 3x in our benchmark workloads.\" Jeff, can you confirm wording with Polaris PR?
Jeff (Marketing): pinged their comms lead. Quick update: they want to soften to "significantly improved" rather than an exact multiplier in public materials. They can approve a specific stat only if we attach the benchmark methodology appendix.
Ana (PM): noted. I prefer the specific stat with appendix, but if that's delayed we should use their suggested language. We need final by EOD tomorrow for the marketplace listing.
Marina (Partner Ops): timeline confirmed with Polaris: they can greenlight the appendix by next Tue, but not today. They asked if we can publish a marketplace teaser now with the softer quote and then swap to the stat later.
Ravi (Design): approved from design POV — teaser layout ready. I’ll prepare two art variants (teaser + full stat) so swapping is trivial.
Sam (Legal): thumbs up on the teaser quote. Also flag: Polaris attached a trademark usage doc. Two points: (1) we must include the TM symbol only on first mention, (2) no modified logos. Design, please ensure the polygon mark isn't cropped.
Ravi (Design): got it — will avoid any cropping, adding min-clear instructions in the export.
asset-bot: Upload complete: Polaris_assets_2026-03-22.zip (3.8MB) — https://files.redwood.example/polaris-assets.zip
Jeff (Marketing): copy for marketplace tile (teaser): \"Redwood + Polaris: simplified, low-latency inference for compute-heavy applications.\" - agree?
Ana (PM): yes, clean. add CTA: "See benchmark & tech brief" and point to the appendix placeholder.
Jeff (Marketing): will send final copy to Polaris for quick OK. Sam — any legal microcopy for the CTA or do we just use the standard marketplace T&Cs?
Sam (Legal): standard T&Cs fine. For the link label avoid "Guaranteed" or numeric claims without appendix.
Marina (Partner Ops): action items: 1) Jeff to get teaser quote OK from Polaris (today) 2) Ravi to export both hero variants and upload 3) Ana to prep appendix skeleton for benchmarks 4) Sam will draft the microcopy note for marketplace 5) I'll coordinate final sign-off.
Ravi (Design): uploading hero variants to the share now. will include PNG + responsive JPGs + an SVG of the lockup.
asset-bot: Upload complete: polaris-hero-variants.zip (12.1MB) — https://files.redwood.example/polaris-hero-variants.zip
Jeff (Marketing): Polaris replied: teaser quote approved, appendix expected by Tue. They prefer we publish teaser tomorrow morning.
Ana (PM): good. final checklist: confirm alt text, confirm TM usage in copy, final art exports, and schedule marketplace publish slot. Can everyone react with :thumbsup: when done?
Ravi (Design): :thumbsup:
Jeff (Marketing): :thumbsup:
Sam (Legal): :thumbsup:
Marina (Partner Ops): :thumbsup:
Ana (PM): thanks all — moving to publish queue.
